scope: Actual Spring/H2 HTTP + STOMP and two native browser sessions; disposable accounts, no physical media or external networks
checks: Concurrent direct creation returns one room for both accounts
Two authenticated browser sessions receive direct text through actual STOMP
Own edit broadcasts live to peer; peer cannot see edit control for received text
Updated direct history survives real browser reload
Authenticated client cannot subscribe to another users notifications
Authenticated client can subscribe to own notifications
Non-member cannot subscribe to room messages or updates
Active member can subscribe to room updates
